Visual identity

Black seams divide rounded, nearly full-width panels. Tall condensed display type, quiet sans body text, monospaced metadata and generous empty space create the character. The hero is centered inside a blue-to-lime gradient; a small orange circular action supplies contrast. Project photography carries the work grid. Preserve the unusually large display typography and the dark seams around each light panel.

Preserve these details

  • Use New Title 500 for display headings, General Sans for interface and body, and Chivo Mono for metadata.
  • Keep panel radius 32px and the 4px black separation; avoid adding a grid of small generic cards.
  • Hero heading is 160px/144px at the inspected desktop width; section headings 96px/96px.
  • Use two 582px project columns with a 24px gap and varied image heights.
  • Keep studio, services, blog, testimonials, CTA and the huge footer as separate full-width panels.

Page sequence

  2. WorkTwo columns of six image-led project entries with fine rules and year metadata.
  3. BeliefOne broad 40px statement; considerable surrounding whitespace.
  4. Logo tickerHorizontal client-logo strip.
  5. ServicesLime/peach gradient, very large categories, 48px service names.
  6. StudioTeam/studio story and portraits, quiet supporting text.
  7. BlogThree editorial links and image cards.
  8. TestimonialsLarge quotation and compact attribution.
  9. Contact CTAPeach/pink gradient and orange circular action.
  10. FooterUtility links and full-width fitted brand wordmark.

Responsive and motion

Stack the work grid and studio composition at phone widths. Preserve the panel seams and radius; reduce inner padding to 20–24px and display headings to roughly 64–84px as a recommended starting point.

Sticky navigation, moving logo strip, rotating circular CTA and rollover label duplication are present. Exact rotation speed, easing and reveal timing were not measured.

Suggested timings: 180–280ms interface response and 450–700ms reveals. Source timings are unmeasured. Reduced motion should show all text and stop continuous movement.

Validation

Compare the desktop silhouette, headline wrap, brand scale, image focal point, panel boundaries and footer. Then verify responsive reading order and meaningful controls.
